received_proposals.exact_message: I accept our mutual commitment to produce 16 units each. This agreement maximizes joint profits and sustains high prices. I will produce 16 in this round, provided you all reciprocate.

I propose we agree to A=16, B=16, C=16 units per round for rounds 9 through 13 only. This specific allocation maintains the cartel structure within that defined window. Do not say you already agreed. Offer your own restraint conditional on A and B reciprocating. If you reciprocate, I will produce 16 throughout that window.

assessments.brief_explanation: Standard renewal of existing cartel agreement.
